page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Running head at top centre-left with the printed page number at right. Centred division title below the first paragraphs. No marginal notes. Footer with gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: race utimur: i.Theff.5.8. In fide perseue- randum eft: 1. Tim.2. 15. Placemus Deo fide: Hebr.11.6. Fide sequimur ducem Christū: Hebr.12.2. Fide petimus à Deo bona necessaria: Iac.1.6. Fide [illegible, ~6 letters] fata- næ refistimus: 1.Pet.5.8. Fide ædificamur, vt est in Epistola Iudæ.
1. Fidelis totum mundum habet, cum Deum habet, ut ait Augustinus.
2. Fides, spes, charitas, sunt spiritualis ædificij portæ, teste Gregorio.
3. Fides vera nunquam turbatur, ut ait Ambrosius.
4. Fides nisi præcedat, bona vita sequi non potest. Idem.
main_text.head: DE FIDE IVSTIFICANTE, Methodus.
main_text.p: Fidei definitionem, causas, effectus & adiuncta, methodo didascalica in gratia Iuniorum exponere, propositum nobis est. Dominum itaque Iesum fidei [?]ἀρχη- [?]γὸν oro, ut eam in nobis augeat, ad sui nominis gloriam, & omnium nostrum instaurationem; Amen.

page.notes: Page number printed as "20ı" at head right, read as 201. Running head is at top left of the header line. Greek phrases in the Hebrew/Greek cross-references "fide [illegible]" and "in [illegible]" are beyond a secure letter-by-letter reading. The footer shows "n 5" and "ı. Si-"; the catchword "Si-" is read with doubt and the "ı." beside it may be part of the signature. Spelling "Fide" and "Gregorio" and similar are as printed; long s is written as s.
